details: Military tensions between the United States and Iran have sharply escalated. The U.S. military confirmed destroying five Iranian oil tankers in response to unsuccessful Iranian missile attacks on a U.S. warship. In retaliation, Iran reportedly launched missiles at U.S. targets in Jordan and attacked ten ships near the Strait of Hormuz. This rapid escalation has pushed Brent crude oil prices above $100 a barrel for the first time since July, fueling concerns about inflation and global energy supply disruptions. Amidst this volatility, Bitcoin's price has stalled near $79,000, reflecting a reduced appetite for risk in the broader financial markets.
title: US-Iran Strikes Escalate, Brent Crude Tops $100, Bitcoin Stalls.

details: Russia has launched intensified drone and missile attacks on Ukraine, targeting the capital Kyiv and surrounding regions. One report from Ukraine's foreign minister described a Russian drone strike on Ukraine's security services HQ as a "major escalation." These ongoing hostilities, including reports of a Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian Caspian Sea port, signal a heightened phase of the conflict. While direct, immediate impacts on cryptocurrency prices were not explicitly detailed in the reputable geopolitical news sources within the last 24 hours, prolonged conflict and instability typically contribute to global economic uncertainty and risk aversion.
title: Russia Intensifies Drone, Missile Attacks on Ukraine, Hits Kyiv.

details: A recent survey by the American Chamber of Commerce in Shanghai (AmCham Shanghai) indicates a notable improvement in confidence among U.S. businesses operating in China. Profitability and optimism for the five-year outlook have reportedly rebounded to their highest levels in years, attributed to more stable bilateral trade relations following a Xi-Trump tariff truce last October. This positive shift in sentiment suggests a calming of trade tensions, which could foster greater economic stability.
title: US Firms More Optimistic in China as Bilateral Relations Stabilize.
